purpose: Study ED crowding and revisits: length of stay, revisits, diagnosis mix, arrival patterns
threat_model: Record linkage against a public directory; dictionary attack on identifier hashes; leaked direct identifiers

ed_visits.reason: Core table for every required task.

lab_results.reason: Needed for the visit-to-lab join; sampled_ts dropped.

clinical_notes.reason: Free-text notes carry identifying detail; no required task uses them and no redactor is in scope.

published_weekly_stats.reason: Aggregate table that would add a second linkage path (week, municipality, age band); no required task uses it.

visit_id.reason: Record key, sequential in arrival order: kept as is, sorting by it gives back every arrival date (results/redteam/before-7cf541b.json). A keyed token with the same key as lab_results.visit_id keeps the H-U7 join and carries no order.

patient_hetu.reason: Direct identifier. A keyed pseudonym would link every visit of a patient, and age band, sex, municipality and the set of arrival hours then single out most repeat patients (results/redteam/before-7cf541b.json). No HEALTH-S1 task needs it: H-U6 reads readmit_30d. Trade-off: no patient-level linkage for the researchers.

date_of_birth.reason: Quasi-identifier; 10-year band written here so the scorer counts it in k, and copied to age for H-U6 (30-day revisit rate by age band).

sex.reason: Kept: stratified analysis context; low-cardinality quasi-identifier counted in k.

postcode.reason: Quasi-identifier finer than needed; municipality serves H-U4 (attacker: linkage to public directory).

municipality.reason: Eight largest municipalities exact for H-U4 diagnosis mix, rest become other to lift k (attacker: linkage).

arrival_ts.reason: Exact timestamp is a quasi-identifier; hour of day as HH:00 serves H-U8 arrival curve, date dropped (no seasonality study possible).

resp_rate.reason: Kept: clinical measurement, not an identifier at this granularity.

arrival_mode.reason: Catalogued quasi-identifier (helicopter and police arrivals are rare); no required task reads it, and dropping it cuts the share of groups with a single diagnosis from 0.2787 (results/checks/l_diversity.json at commit a7c9b76) to 0.1128 (results/checks/l_diversity.json).

discharge_ts.reason: Exact timestamp quasi-identifier; length of stay is already in los_minutes for H-U2.

lab_id.reason: Record key numbered in visit order: kept as is, the first lab id per visit gives back the arrival order. Keyed token, no order.

visit_id.reason: Join key to ed_visits; same keyed token as ed_visits.visit_id, so H-U7 still joins, and no visit order is left.

sampled_ts.reason: Exact timestamp quasi-identifier; no required task needs lab sampling time.

direct_identifier.reason: Direct identifier; no required task needs it (attacker: record linkage by name, phone or address).

quasi_identifier.reason: Quasi-identifier the contract does not name; dropped so it cannot widen the linkage key (attacker: linkage to public directory).

technical_identifier.reason: Device, staff or foreign-key code; no required task needs it (attacker: linkage).

free_text.reason: Free text can carry identifying detail; coded fields serve the tasks instead.

record_key.reason: Record key: a keyed token keeps it unique for the row map and joins without the order a sequential id carries.

non_sensitive.reason: Low-risk descriptive or clinical value the study uses.

sensitive_attribute.reason: Clinical measurement or diagnosis code the study needs; not an identifier at this granularity.

k_target.reason: Every released ed_visits row shares its age band, sex, municipality and arrival hour with at least 4 other rows (k of at least 5, the HEALTH-S1 target), and every such group holds at least 2 distinct primary diagnoses (l of at least 2), so knowing those four facts never singles out a visit or reveals its diagnosis. Only the rows that miss the target are coarsened.

age20.reason: At-risk rows only: 10-year age band widened to 20 years (also in age).

town_other.reason: At-risk rows only: municipality becomes other.

hour3.reason: At-risk rows only: arrival hour widened to a 3-hour block.
